text: The decentralized economy cannot fully proliferate until it acquires the institutions ordinary commerce depends on, above all a secure and meaningful reputation system for anonymous supranational partners and an effective, dynamic governance system.
citation: Craig Calcaterra, Wulf A. Kaal, Decentralized Finance (DeFi) (2021). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3782216
abstract: the decentralized economy is missing the major institutions that our society relies on to conduct profitable business, especially a secure and meaningful system for evaluating reputation for anonymous supranational partners, and an effective and dynamic governance system

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: the decentralized economy as of the early 2020s
